blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The House of Representatives is prepared to join the Senate in striking out from next year’s proposed P7.2-trillion national budget infrastructure line items lacking documentation, lawmakers said on Monday, amid criticism of projects without pertinent documents. FPJ Panday Bayanihan party-list Rep. Brian Poe said the House will reject projects without detailed plans and paper trails as including them in the 2027 budget will be unfair for their constituencies and undermine careful district infrastructure planning. “We will not accept projects that do not have proper papers or proper coordinates because that is unfair to the constituents,” Poe, an assistant […]...
